description: Look up ONE loan or lease in an ABS-EE asset-level disclosure filing by accession number and asset number: original loan amount, term, rate, origination and maturity dates, vehicle, period-end balance, delinquency days, zero-balance code and the full set of disclosed fields for that reporting period. Reads SEC EDGAR asset-data exhibits (Regulation AB II) by streaming the exhibit and stopping at the match; a very large exhibit can take up to about a minute. An asset number that is not in the exhibit returns reason asset_not_found only after the whole exhibit was read; an interrupted read returns scan_incomplete, never a false not-found.

cik.description: Optional filer CIK the filing sits under, when it differs from the accession prefix.

name: abs_asset_lookup

fields.description: Every disclosed field of the asset row; repeated tags are arrays

summary.description: Key fields of the asset row (amounts in USD, percentages as decimal fractions, delinquency in days)

title: Abs Asset Lookup
